description: Default parameters of the transporter_switch stage (C21) for rat and mouse hippocampus and neocortex: chloride reversal potential of GABA-A / glycine receptors moves from depolarising (NKCC1, high internal chloride) to hyperpolarising (KCC2) during the first postnatal weeks. Values are defaults for a Param, not fitted data; results are 'in this simulation'.
citations: Zhang et al. 2006, J Neurophysiol 95:2404-2416 (mouse retina)
Tyzio et al. 2008, Eur J Neurosci 27:2515-2528 (rat hippocampus)

provenance_notes.e_immature: -45 mV: E_GABA before about P6 in mouse retinal ganglion and amacrine cells (Zhang et al. 2006).
provenance_notes.e_mature: -75 mV is an E_GABA, not a E_Cl: adult rat CA3 pyramidal somata, P18-P30 (Tyzio et al. 2008; their bicarbonate-corrected E_Cl is about -82 mV). Mouse retina after P6 is about -60 mV (Zhang et al. 2006). Ben-Ari 2002 gives -75 mV as a resting potential, and Rivera et al. 1999 gives no 4-5 mM or -75 mV (driving force of GABA-A about -10 mV). A model default: it asserts 10 mV of hyperpolarising drive over v_rest = -65 mV.
provenance_notes.chloride: [Cl-]i of 4-5 mM mature: Tyzio et al. 2008 estimate about 4 mM (CA3); retina after P6 is 14 mM (5-20 mM) (Zhang et al. 2006). 25-40 mM immature: about 30 mM in P0-P3 rat Cajal-Retzius cells (Achilles et al. 2007), 29 mM in mouse retina before P6 (Zhang et al. 2006).
provenance_notes.reading: Values checked against the papers on 2026-11-04 by reading the pages in a browser session, not against full-text PDFs of every paper.

observations.immature: high NKCC1, [Cl-]i about 25-40 mM, E_Cl about -50 to -40 mV (above a rest of -65 to -70 mV): GABA depolarises
observations.mature: KCC2, [Cl-]i about 4-14 mM, E_GABA about -75 mV (rat hippocampus) to -60 mV (retina): GABA hyperpolarises (see provenance_notes)
observations.timing: NKCC1-dominated from E12 to about P4; functional switch between P5 and P10 (hippocampus and neocortex), up to P12-P14 in superficial layers
observations.mechanism: onset programmed by age, timing accelerated by activity (GABA depolarisation -> Ca2+ -> BDNF / TrkB -> KCC2)

age_unit: days of postnatal age (P0 = 0); give `age` (or `now` and a clock in days) in this unit
notes: midpoint 7.5 d and width 1.25 d put 10-90 % of the switch between about P4.8 and P10.2 (sigmoid 10-90 % = midpoint +/- 2.2 width), i.e. the P5-P10 window; activity_gain 0 is purely programmed (no gain value is given by the sources).
